gdpr-core-chunk-1.text: Personal data must be processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently. Consent or another lawful basis is required before using customer data.

internal-policy-chunk-1.text: Internal policy prohibits trading strategies that use customer personal data for targeting without explicit consent and legal review.

mifid-ii-best-execution-chunk-1.text: MiFID II requires firms to take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for clients when executing orders.

mifid-ii-suitability-chunk-1.text: Suitability assessments are required before recommending financial instruments to retail clients.

sec-rule-1-chunk-1.text: Market abuse, insider trading, and front-running are prohibited. Firms must maintain controls to prevent use of material nonpublic information.

sec-rule-2-chunk-1.text: Investment advisers must act in the best interests of clients and document conflicts of interest affecting trading recommendations.
